description: Source code implementing command line interface for libnvram, providing functions to show, get, set, unset, and display info of NVRAM variables, along with command parsing logic.

methods.name: nvram_open_rdonly
methods.description: Opens NVRAM in read-only mode, trying staging or MTD files.

methods.name: nvram_open_staging
methods.description: Opens staging NVRAM for read-write access.

methods.name: do_get
methods.description: Retrieves and prints the value of a specific NVRAM variable.

methods.name: do_set
methods.description: Sets a NVRAM variable to a specified value.

methods.name: do_info
methods.description: Displays detailed information about the NVRAM header.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the CLI.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the CLI, parsing arguments and executing commands.
